subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The news channel described the event in **__graphic__** detail.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Vivid."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Graphic" means (used about descriptions) clear and giving a lot of detail, especially about something unpleasant. ((वर्णन) स्‍पष्‍ट और सुविस्‍तृत (विशेषतः किसी अप्रिय स्थिति का))
 
 
• Example: *She described the accident in **graphic**__ detail.*
 
 
 
• ​So, the synonym of "Graphic" is "Vivid."
 
• The word "Vivid" means having or producing a strong, clear picture in your mind. (सजीव और सुस्‍पष्‍ट (प्रभाव होने व उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला))
 __
 
• Example: *He gave a very **vivid**__ and often shocking description.*
 
 
 
• 
 
Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore other options:
 
 
• **Starling: **a common bird with black or dark brown feathers that lives in large groups in many parts of the world. (काले या गहरे भूरे पंखों वाला एक सामान्य पक्षी जो दुनिया के कई हिस्सों में बड़े समूहों में रहता है)
 
• **Mirthful: **full of mirth; merry or amusing. (उल्लास से भरपूर; आनंदमय या मनोरंजक)
 
• **Comic: **that makes you laugh; connected with comedy. (हास्‍यजनक, हँसानेवाला; सुखांत-रचना से संबंधित)
